item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
Your languages, and words the model keeps getting wrong

  • No more guessing the language. A wrong guess does not make a typo, it translates the sentence. You name the languages you speak, and the orb's language button switches between them with a click, or with Cmd Shift L from anywhere.
  • Setup asks which languages, not which language, in the order you pick them, offering the ones your Mac already knows. Settings shows that same order, ready to drag into shape.
  • Vocabulary is honest about its ceiling. The model reads only twenty to thirty five words before a dictation, so Kazhy measures in the units it counts, shows where you stand, and marks what it cannot send. No word is refused any more.
  • Replacements fix what the model still writes wrong, after it writes it: a pair of what was heard and what should be written, with no limit on how many you keep.
  • Fixed: on a second display, the status label beside the recording orb could appear on the wrong screen.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• AI Styles keep your words: product names, technical terms and the small words that change what a sentence claims all survive.
  • No more invisible characters that broke when pasted into a terminal or a commit message.
  • Styling is faster.
  • New styles: Commit message and Shorter.
  • Punctuation only and Slack message are retired. If you had one selected, you are now on Polish.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
• Your free week is now actually offered. Setup asks you to sign in, and that is what starts seven days of full Premium — cloud transcription and AI Styles, no card. The week already existed, but nothing ever offered it: unless you went looking for the sign-in yourself it never began.
  • Skip the step and the menu bar keeps the offer open.
  • The paid screens speak your language. Settings, Plans and AI Styles were falling back to English in every language but one — on the screens you pay on.
  • The menu has a direct line for feedback.
  • Kazhy stays dark whatever your system appearance is.
